description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It encapsulates filtering parameters for employee skills, specifically including an employee number property and associated getter/setter methods. It appears to be used for constructing search filters in the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Represents filter parameters for searching employee skills, including sorting and employee number filtering. Extends the base FilterParams class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class and sets the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.
